The corridor is 5 lanes wide, numbered 1 to 5 from the north wall. You are in lane 3, walking east. Another person, Person 2, is in lane 3, 6 cells ahead, walking west towards you. Person 2 says: "I'm moving to lane 2." Which lane do you move to, if you move?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Lane 4  
Since Person 2 moves to their right (lane 2), you should move to your right (lane 4) so you pass safely.
